tool.name: OGS: ResetPropertiesInPolygonalRegion
tool.description: Galaxy wrapper for the OGS utility 'ResetPropertiesInPolygonalRegion'.
tool.command: ln -sf '$geometry' '$geometry.gli'; ln -sf '$mesh_input_file' '$mesh_input_file.vtu'; ln -sf '$gmsh_path' '$gmsh_path.msh'; ResetPropertiesInPolygonalRegion #if str($polygon_name) --polygon-name '$polygon_name' #end if --geometry '$geometry.gli' $any_of #if str($char_property_value) --char-property-value '$char_property_value' #end if #if str($int_property_value) --int-property-value '$int_property_value' #end if #if str($property_name) --property-name '$property_name' #end if #if str($restrict_to_MaterialID) --restrict-to-MaterialID '$restrict_to_MaterialID' #end if --mesh-input-file '$mesh_input_file.vtu' --gmsh-path '$gmsh_path.msh' --mesh-output-file output_1.vtu

param.label: polygon name
param.help: name of polygon in the geometry

param.label: geometry
param.help: Input (.gli | .gml). The name of the file containing the input geometry

param.label: any of
param.help: all nodes of an element has to be inside the polygon (default behaviour without switch) or any node of an element has to be inside (switch is given)

param.label: property name
param.help: name of property in the mesh

param.label: restrict to MaterialID
param.help: Restrict resetting the property to the material id

param.label: mesh input file
param.help: Input (.vtu | .vtk | .msh). The name of the file containing the input mesh

param.label: gmsh path
param.help: Input (.msh). The path to the input binary

tool.help: This tool runs the **ResetPropertiesInPolygonalRegion** utility from the OpenGeoSys suite.
